script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$d=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Acceptance-20261102-r3'
$paths=@('C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe',(Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'))
$p=@($paths|Where-Object {Test-Path -LiteralPath $_})[0]
if(-not $p){throw 'Chrome executable not found'}
$profile=Join-Path $d 'chrome-profile'
if(Test-Path $profile){throw 'Profile already exists'}
$c=Start-Process -FilePath $p -ArgumentList ('--user-data-dir="'+$profile+'"'),'--remote-debugging-port=19331','--no-first-run','--no-default-browser-check','--new-window','--window-size=1150,800','chrome://extensions/' -PassThru
$br=[IO.BinaryReader]::new([IO.File]::OpenRead($p));$br.BaseStream.Position=60;$offset=$br.ReadInt32();$br.BaseStream.Position=$offset+4;$machine=$br.ReadUInt16();$br.Dispose()
@{browserPath=$p;version=(Get-Item $p).VersionInfo.ProductVersion;peMachine=('0x{0:X4}' -f $machine);profile=$profile;browserPID=$c.Id;debugPort=19331}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
